citation_shape_rule: One concrete support sentence uses one most-direct citation; no manuscript sentence may contain more than one citation command, and multi-key commands, adjacent piles, ranges, and paragraph-final stacks are rejected.
count_method: Complete bibliography traversal with contiguous terminal-number verification; no metadata-based count estimates.
floor_policy: The manuscript must use at least the ceiling of the verified median (78). This is a coverage floor, not permission to pad. Every retained item must be a genuine scholarly publication, strongly related, individually cited by a sentence-level claim, and represented in citation_support.csv.
floor_rule: The manuscript must contain at least the ceiling of the verified median (78). The P75 is descriptive, never a quota, and every retained reference must independently satisfy relevance and sentence-level support.

inspection_method.pdf_screenshot_attempt: attempted for each PDF as required by the environment; web screenshot cache misses prevented image capture, so parsed PDF text and terminal entries were used and the limitation is recorded rather than concealed
inspection_method.primary: full-text bibliography traversal and terminal-number verification

manuscript_eligibility_rule: Only genuine, verified, strongly related scholarly papers are eligible; websites, repositories, documentation, standards pages, product pages, blogs, and padding are excluded.
